note: Mutants of the admin page's door in docker/nginx.conf (the internal gate, the auth_request of /admin/api/, its answers and its allowance; docs/HUB.md 'The admin page's door') for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'): each breaks one rule on purpose, and tests/scripts/test_nginx_submissions.py must notice, running the real blocks in front of a stand-in gate and a stand-in game server. Run from the checkout, no build needed: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/nginx_admin_door_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. Not listed on purpose: the gate's query and its body. nginx's auth_request makes its subrequest with no query and with an empty body whatever the block says, so the gate's explicit address and `proxy_pass_request_body off;` are second locks, and a mutant of either is equivalent (nothing a test can see changes). The mutants need an nginx program on the machine (without one they cannot be caught and show as survived).

mutants.new:
# (the decoded and normalized path is what goes on upstream, so only plain characters may be in it)
        if ($uri !~ "^/admin/api/
